missions.name: The Orchard Road
missions.description: Lead Able platoon through the orchard, destroy the blocking armor, then secure the village crossroads.

missions.name: Pine Ridge
missions.description: Hold the pine ridge until relief arrives. Bring at least one surviving vehicle to the rally point while resisting the armored ambush.

missions.name: Iron Counterattack
missions.description: Command the opposing platoon across open farmland and seize the depot road.
